name: Daidou
source:
The manager of the convenience store closest to Kiichi's apartment. 

[Spoiler] The number one "Feeler" in the Vatican's rankings. He has depraved more targets, earned more money from videos and sent more women onto the ark than anyone else. Kiichi does not initially realise he is the number one Feeler until they are formally introduced at the Vatican's gathering. 

In addition to his first-rate techniques, Daidou uses his tall physique to hide his targets from view in crowded trains so that he can have his way with them. Like Kiichi, he has a "nose" which can tell what state of arousal his target is experiencing which he can manipulate at will. 

Daidou uses his convenience store manager profession to complement his Chikan activities. In his words, the large variety of female customers who patronise his store hone his eye and help him choose his targets through conversation and observation. 

He is surprised at how rapidly Kiichi climbed the Vatican ranks and challenged him to a Chikan duel. Well aware of his established status, he gave Kiichi enough time to choose his targets whereas he was indiscriminate and settled for anything during the duel. Although it ended in a draw, Daidou was impressed by Kiichi's performance and was happy to challenge him again in the future, this time on equal terms. [/Spoiler]
